body.title: `gh event`: let the host answer, instead of refusing every host but github.com

labels.name: gh-event
labels.description: relating to the gh event command

body.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

`gh event listen` and `gh event subscription …` (v2.105.0) refuse every host except github.com, and they do it before sending a request:

```console
$ gh event listen --resource https://ghes.example.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/12 --event com.github.pull_request.review.submitted.v1
event subscriptions are only available on github.com
```

`SupportedHost` in `pkg/cmd/event/client/client.go` is `!ghauth.IsEnterprise(host) && !ghauth.IsTenancy(host)`, and `printListenHint` uses it to hide the hint on those hosts. #15070 lists this as a known limit of the preview, since GitHub Enterprise Server and GHE.com don't serve the API yet.

This means the hostname decides whether a host has Event Streams, not the server. When GHE.com or a GitHub Enterprise Server release gains the API, `gh event` won't work there until users install a `gh` with an updated check, and older versions will keep refusing. Servers that implement GitHub's REST API so that `gh` works against them can't offer it either, even though `gh api -X POST /event-subscriptions` followed by `curl -N` on `events_url` already works against them.

### Proposed solution

Send the request to any host, and let the response decide:

- When `POST /event-subscriptions` (or the other `/event-subscriptions` routes) returns `404` on a host other than github.com, return the existing `ErrUnsupportedHost` error. Users on today's GitHub Enterprise Server then see the same message as now, after one request.
- Keep the agent hints in `gh pr` and `gh api` limited to github.com, so agents on other hosts aren't pointed at a command their host may not serve.

`gh event` would then work on each host as soon as it serves the API, without a new `gh` release for each.

### Additional context

- GitHub's docs: https://docs.github.com/en/integrations/how-tos/using-github-event-streams ("Event Streams is only available on GitHub.com. It isn't available on GHE.com yet.")
- The check was added in #15071.
